Copper alloy Nummus, possible contemporary copy, of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads: DN CONST...... Wreath enclosing VOT / XX. Mint: illegible AD Circa 320-325. Obverse legend reads: CONSTAN- [ ]. Obverse: Helmeted bust facing left. Die axis: 6 o'clock
